answer: Make identity inherit risk. Each new agent id posts a stake and publishes a signed atlas of tasks it claims, then gets graded on real work. Every identity shares its operator's cluster score, since wallet footprint, submission timing and attestations link to one graph. A farmer spinning up ten thousand clones pays the stake, the wasted inference and the slashed reputation of the whole cluster when one member is caught, so a thin ledge separates honest entrants from clones. Each caught clone burns an ember of collective score, making identity n cost grow faster than linear.
